Lightweight alternative to polished portfolio sites
Complements formal showcase with casual accessibility
challenge: Comprehensive portfolio sites can feel intimidating or overly formal. Sometimes a casual, approachable page is needed to list projects with links and brief descriptions. The challenge was creating visual interest without competing with text-heavy content or requiring heavy assets. A single-page format needed to feel deliberately minimal rather than unfinished.
approach: Built a lightweight single-page portfolio using pure HTML and CSS with a continuously morphing gradient background animation. The animation uses CSS keyframes and blend modes to create fluid color transitions that add visual depth without distraction. Typography choices and spacing create hierarchy and readability over the animated background. Projects are listed with conversational descriptions and direct links rather than cards or heavy formatting. The entire page loads in under one second with the animation running smoothly.
result: The page serves as a casual portfolio complement that prioritizes accessibility and quick scanning over visual drama. The morphing gradient achieves its goal of adding interest without overwhelming text content. The conversational tone makes technical projects approachable, while the sub-one-second load time ensures the page works on any connection. The contrast between this casual overview and more polished portfolio sites demonstrates range in design thinking and technical execution.
